[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
鲧伯取土
熊梦微/改编 猫咪饭饭/绘
人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
鲧伯取土
熊梦徽/改编
猫咪饭饭/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] 哗啦啦——哗啦啦——
妹妹望着雨，长长地叹了口气。
唉！连着下了许久的雨，洪水把房子都淹没了！

[P4] “洪水什么时候才走啊？它已经霸占我们的地方这么久了。”妹妹不高兴地嘟起了嘴。
“我知道！可以用土把洪水赶走。鲧伯就是这样做的。”哥哥凑了过来。
“鲧伯？”妹妹疑惑地看着哥哥。
“听说他是黄帝的孙子，是天上的神仙，长得像白马，可以变成人呢！”哥哥认真地说。

[P5] “没错。很久以前，人间发生了一场大洪水，田地被淹没了，房子也被冲垮了，大家连饭都吃不饱。”祖母补充道。
天哪！洪水太可怕啦！
妹妹捂住了嘴巴，眼睛瞪得圆圆的。

[P6] 哥哥接着说：“后来呀，善良的鲧伯决定想办法帮助人们治理洪水，可是鲧伯想了许久都没想出办法来。有只神龟提醒他，可以用息壤来止住洪水。息壤是天帝的宝贝，只要放到地上，就会不停地长出很多土，很容易挡住洪水。”

[P7] 所以，鲧伯去问天帝借息壤了？”妹妹着急地问道。
“嗯！可惜，天帝不肯借！还把鲧伯赶出来了。”哥哥点点头。
“哼！天帝真小气！”妹妹气愤极了。鲧伯可是帮助大家治理洪水的好人呢！
“没有办法，鲧伯只好去偷息壤。”哥哥接着说。
“偷？”妹妹大声说道。
“是的，鲧伯是为了救大家才决定去偷的！”哥哥大声说。

[P8] “爹爹教了，偷东西是不对的！”妹妹坚定地摇头。
“那……那也不能怪鲧伯，他没有其他办法了。为了救大家，鲧伯还受了伤，大家都非常感谢他呢。”哥哥小声嘟囔着。
是吗？可是，妹妹一想到如果是自己心爱的珍宝被偷走，就难过得瘪起了嘴。
哥哥小心地看了看妹妹。

[P9] “只能偷吗？难道除了息壤，就没有其他的办法了吗？”妹妹望着哥哥。
“鲧伯没想出来，你可以帮帮他吗？”哥哥说道。
“我知道！”妹妹指着窗外说，“要让雨停下来！”
“可是，地上还有很多水呢！怎么办？”哥哥又发现了一个新的问题。

[P10] 这可难倒了妹妹。是呀，地上那么多水，怎么办呢？
妹妹忍不住站了起来，趴到窗边望着外面的洪水。
让水流到别的地方去？可是，流去哪儿呢？
地底下？地下已经都是水了，流不走啦！
用土挡？用土挡！
妹妹有些理解鲧伯的做法了。

[P11] 哥哥跟着一起看向外面，长长地叹了口气。
之前他也帮鲧伯想了很久呢。
“哥哥，鲧伯怎么受伤了？”想了许久没想
出办法来，妹妹又想起哥哥说的话来。
蹭蹭蹭！哥哥跑进了书房。

[P12] “你看！”哥哥把画放到妹妹面前，指着弱水说，“天帝把息壤藏在昆仑山上，山下面有弱水，一片羽毛都浮不起来。”
“这可怎么办？”妹妹担心道。
“后来，神龟答应可以带鲧伯渡过弱水。”
“呼——太好了！”妹妹松了口气。

[P13] “你高兴得太早啦！”哥哥看着妹妹，接着说，“鲧伯到了藏着息壤的宝阁。可是，有只恶兽挡在门口。”
“嘶——”妹妹吸了口冷气。

[P14] “恶兽还会喷火呢！鲧伯非常艰难地打赢了它，身上好几处都被火烧伤了。”
“哎呀——那可真疼啊！”妹妹皱了皱眉。
“后来，鲧伯终于拿到了息壤，平息洪水拯救了人们。”

[P15] “好棒好棒！”妹妹拍手欢呼。
“可是，没过多久天帝就发现鲧伯偷了息壤。
于是，他派火神祝融去追捕鲧伯。”哥哥叹了口气。

[P16] “后来呢？后来呢？”妹妹着急地问。
“祝融在羽郊这个地方找到了鲧伯，收回息壤后就把鲧伯杀死了。”
“鲧伯太可怜了。”妹妹不满地说。
“人们也是这样认为的。鲧伯死后，过了好久尸体都没有变化呢。”哥哥点点头。

[P17] “那他复活了吗？”妹妹期盼地看着哥哥。
“没有呢。但是后来他的肚子裂开，生出了天神禹。”哥哥收起了画。
“哥哥，后来呢？我还要听，还要听嘛——”
“后来，鲧伯死后，他的儿子大禹继续治水……”
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Reading · Classic Chinese Mythological Stories
Gun Bo Takes Earth
Adapted by Xiong Mengwei, Illustrated by Māo Mī Fàn Fàn
People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythology Picture Book
Gun Bo Takes Earth
Xiong Menghui / Adapted
Miaomiao Fanfan / Illustrated
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] Splash—splash—
Sister looked at the rain and sighed deeply.
Oh! It has been raining for so long, the flood has submerged the houses!

[P4] "When will the flood go away? It has been taking over our land for so long." The younger sister pouted unhappily.
"I know! We can use earth to drive away the flood. Gunbo did it this way." The older brother leaned in.
"Gunbo?" The younger sister looked at her brother with doubt.
"I heard he is the grandson of the Yellow Emperor, a celestial immortal, who looks like a white horse and can turn into a human!" The older brother said seriously.

[P5] "That's right. A long time ago, a great flood happened in the human world. The fields were flooded, houses were washed away, and everyone couldn't even eat enough food," Grandma added.
Oh my! Floods are so terrifying!
The younger sister covered her mouth, her eyes wide open.

[P6] The older brother continued, "Later, the kind Gun decided to find a way to help people control the flood, but Gun thought for a long time and couldn't come up with a solution. A divine turtle reminded him that he could use Xirang to stop the flood. Xirang is the treasure of the Heavenly Emperor; as long as it is placed on the ground, it will keep growing more soil and easily block the floodwater."

[P7] "So, did Gun go to borrow Xirang from the Heavenly Emperor?" the younger sister asked anxiously.
"Yes! Unfortunately, the Heavenly Emperor refused! He even drove Gun away," the older brother nodded.
"Hmph! The Heavenly Emperor is so stingy!" the younger sister said angrily. Gun was a good person who helped everyone control the floods!
"There was no other way, so Gun had to steal the Xirang," the older brother continued.
"Steal?" the younger sister shouted.
"Yes, Gun decided to steal it in order to save everyone!" the older brother shouted back.

[P8] "Dad taught us, stealing is wrong!" the younger sister shook her head firmly.
"Well... we can't blame Gunbo. He had no other choice. He got injured while saving everyone, and everyone is very grateful to him," the older brother murmured softly.
Really? But the younger sister, thinking about her own beloved treasure being stolen, pouted sadly.
The older brother looked at his sister carefully.

[P9] "Can we only steal? Is there really no other way besides the Xirang?" the younger sister looked at her brother.
"Gun didn't think of one, can you help him?" the brother said.
"I know!" the younger sister pointed out the window, "We need to stop the rain!"
"But there's still so much water on the ground! What should we do?" the brother realized a new problem.

[P10] This stumped the younger sister. Indeed, there was so much water on the ground—what could be done?
The younger sister couldn’t help but stand up and peer out the window at the floodwaters.
What if we let the water flow to another place? But where could it go?
Underground? The underground was already full of water—it couldn’t flow away!
Use earth to block it? Use earth to block it!
The younger sister began to understand Gun’s actions.

[P11] The older brother looked out with her, sighing deeply.
He had also been thinking hard about how to help Gun for a long time.
"Brother, how did Gun get hurt?" After thinking for a long time without finding a solution, the younger sister remembered what her brother had said.
Zeng zeng zeng! The brother ran into the study.

[P12] "Look!" the older brother placed the painting in front of his sister, pointing to the Weak Water and said, "The Heavenly Emperor hid the Xirang in Mount Kunlun. Below the mountain is the Weak Water, where not even a single feather can float." 
"What can we do?" the younger sister worriedly asked. 
"Later, the divine turtle agreed to carry Gun Bo across the Weak Water." 
"Phew—great!" the younger sister sighed in relief.

[P13] "You're getting too excited too soon!" the older brother looked at his sister and continued, "Gong Bo has reached the treasure hall where the Xirang is hidden. But there's a fierce beast blocking the entrance." 
"Ssshh—" the younger sister sucked in a cold breath.

[P14] "The monster could even breathe fire! Gun伯 struggled hard to defeat it and got burned in several places." 
"Oh—how painful that must be!" the younger sister frowned. 
"Later, Gun伯 finally got the Xirang and calmed the flood, saving the people."

[P15] "Great job, great job!" the younger sister clapped her hands in excitement.
"But soon after, the Heavenly Emperor discovered that Gun Bo had stolen the Xi Rang.
So he sent the Fire God Zhu Rong to chase and capture Gun Bo," the older brother sighed.

[P16] "What happened next? What happened next?" the younger sister asked anxiously.
"Zhu Rong found Gun Bo in Yu Jiao, took back the Xi Rang, and then killed Gun Bo."
"Gun Bo is so pitiful," the younger sister said, dissatisfied.
"People think the same way. After Gun Bo died, his body didn't change for a long time," the older brother nodded.

[P17] "Did he come back to life?" the younger sister asked, looking at her brother with anticipation.
"No. But later, his belly split open and the god Yu was born." The older brother put away the painting.
"Brother, what happened next? I want to hear more, I want to hear more—"
"Later, after Gun died, his son Dayu continued to control the floods..."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《鲧伯取土》的封面，展示了神话人物鲧伯与一位手持宝盒的长者在云间对峙的场景，上方标有书名、作者及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《鲧伯取土》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者及出版社信息，画面中央为神话人物鲧伯立于云间，手持宝盒，背景为祥云与飞石。
[P3] 画面描绘了持续降雨导致洪水泛滥的场景，一个小女孩在窗边望着被淹没的房屋，感到担忧和无奈。
[P4] 两个孩子在洪水泛滥的背景下对话，妹妹担忧洪水何时退去，哥哥则介绍传说中的鲧伯能用土治水，并描述他为能化为人形的白马神仙。
[P5] 祖母向孩子们讲述很久以前人间发生大洪水的惨状，妹妹听后感到非常害怕。
[P6] 哥哥讲述鲧伯在治理洪水时陷入困境，后得到神龟指点，得知可用天帝的宝贝息壤来止住洪水。
[P7] 哥哥向妹妹讲述鲧伯因天帝不肯借息壤而被迫偷取，妹妹对此感到震惊和不解，但哥哥强调鲧伯是为了拯救大家才做出此举。
[P8] 妹妹认为偷东西不对，对鲧伯偷取息壤的行为表示不解和难过，哥哥则解释鲧伯是为救大家才不得已为之，并观察妹妹的情绪。
[P9] 妹妹对鲧伯偷取息壤的行为表示不解，询问是否有其他办法；哥哥请妹妹帮忙想办法，妹妹提出要让雨停下来，哥哥则意识到即使雨停，地上仍有大量积水，面临新的难题。
[P10] 妹妹面对洪水泛滥的困境，思考如何排水，最终想到用土阻挡，开始理解鲧伯偷取息壤治水的做法。
[P11] 哥哥和妹妹望着窗外的洪水，妹妹担心鲧伯受伤，哥哥思考后跑进书房，似乎在寻找解决办法。
[P12] 哥哥向妹妹展示画作，解释天帝将息壤藏于昆仑山下，而山下有无法浮起羽毛的弱水，妹妹担忧不已；哥哥告知神龟愿意带鲧伯渡过弱水，妹妹这才松了一口气。
[P13] 哥哥告诉妹妹，鲧伯虽已抵达藏有息壤的宝阁，但门口有恶兽阻拦，妹妹听后感到惊惧。
[P14] 哥哥讲述鲧伯战胜喷火恶兽、取得息壤并最终平息洪水拯救百姓的故事，妹妹听后既心疼又感到欣慰。
[P15] 妹妹为鲧伯成功取得息壤而欢呼，哥哥则叹息道天帝很快发现此事，并派火神祝融追捕鲧伯。
[P16] 妹妹追问鲧伯的后续，哥哥告知祝融找到鲧伯并将其杀死，妹妹感到同情，哥哥补充说鲧伯死后尸体许久未变。
[P17] 妹妹询问鲧伯是否复活，哥哥解释鲧伯死后肚子裂开生出大禹，并告知大禹将继承治水事业，妹妹表现出继续听故事的渴望。
[P18] 画面中，一位神祇坐在云朵上，手持彩虹，下方是一匹装饰华丽的白马在波涛中行走，背景为山峦与浪花，整体呈现神话氛围。
